To qu…

items.title: CVE-2026-107494: OpenSSL denial of service in QUIC connection ID frames (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. OpenSSL's QUIC stack has a flaw where it queues a RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frame for retransmitted NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames as well. A remote malicious QUIC peer could use this to queue an unlimited number of those frames.

items.title: CVE-2026-95643: Zoho DDI Central authenticated command injection in Telnet connectivity (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Zohocorp ManageEngine DDI Central is affected by an authenticated PowerShell command injection flaw in its Telnet connectivity feature. An attacker who can reach the product over the network and log in with high privileges can use specially crafted IPv6 scope identifiers to run arbitrary commands on managed Windows nodes.

items.title: CVE-2026-95645: Zoho DDI Central authenticated command injection in clear_blocked_domains (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Zohocorp ManageEngine DDI Central builds before the fixed release contain an authenticated command injection flaw in the Windows DDI Agent's clear_blocked_domains function. An attacker with high-privilege login credentials can reach it over the network and use specially crafted blocked-domain values to run arbitrary commands on Windows systems.

items.title: CVE-2026-129182: PHP memory corruption via stale last_fatal_error_backtrace
items.summary: A use-after-free flaw in PHP (from the PHP Group) lets an attacker corrupt memory, crash PHP-FPM or mod_php workers, and possibly run their own code. It can be reached remotely without logging in, but only on servers with specific per-path or per-directory configuration, where a fatal error during request shutdown leaves stale data that a later request on the same worker then uses.

items.title: CVE-2026-129481: PHP memory corruption in session shutdown cleanup
items.summary: PHP's session extension has a use-after-free flaw: if a fatal error occurs in an application callback during session shutdown, a stale pointer to the script filename can later be freed by another request handled by the same worker. An attacker who can trigger such a failing cleanup could crash the worker or corrupt memory, reaching it remotely without logging in, though it only applies when the...

items.title: CVE-2026-99306: Linux kernel out-of-bounds read in Ceph MDS map handling (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Linux kernel's Ceph filesystem client can read past the end of a stack buffer when handling a metadata server map from a monitor. An attacker who can send a crafted map claiming more ranks than the buffer holds could cause a memory-safety fault in the kernel.

items.title: CVE-2026-99304: Linux kernel out-of-bounds read in Ceph snap trace bounds check (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Linux kernel's Ceph filesystem client has an integer overflow in its snapshot trace bounds check. A malicious or compromised metadata server can send a crafted snapshot message that makes the kernel read memory past the end of the received message buffer. No action by the client is needed, since the read can happen when the client processes an unsolicited snapshot message, an MDS reply, or ...

items.title: CVE-2026-99310: Linux kernel use-after-free in NFSD open owner tracking (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. A flaw in the Linux kernel's NFS server (nfsd) can cause a use-after-free memory error when it handles a client identification request with mismatched credentials at the same time as another request is freeing client state. An attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in, which could let them take control of the system or crash it.

items.title: CVE-2017-7577: Arbitrary file read via directory traversal in HTTP server (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. XiongMai uc-httpd has a directory traversal flaw that lets an attacker read arbitrary files on the system. An attacker can exploit it remotely, without logging in, by sending a crafted "GET ../" HTTP request.

items.title: CVE-2026-130968: Google Chrome sandbox escape for code execution in Views (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. A use-after-free flaw in the Views component of Google Chrome on Windows lets an attacker run arbitrary code outside the browser's sandbox. The attacker can reach it remotely without logging in, by tricking a user into installing or interacting with a crafted Chrome extension.

items.title: CVE-2026-130926: Google Chrome sandbox escape via confused deputy in Sync (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. A flaw in the Sync feature of Google Chrome lets an attacker who has already compromised the browser's renderer process potentially run arbitrary code outside the sandbox. It can be reached remotely, without logging in or any user interaction, by sending crafted network traffic.

items.title: CVE-2026-131043: Google Chrome sandbox escape to code execution in HID (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. A use-after-free flaw in the HID component of Google Chrome lets an attacker run arbitrary code outside the browser's sandbox. The attack works remotely without logging in, but it relies on social engineering: the victim must be tricked into installing a crafted Chrome extension.

items.title: CVE-2024-32651: changedetection.io remote command execution via Jinja2 templates (Update: Metasploit module published)
items.summary: Update: Metasploit module published. changedetection.io is an open source web page change detection, website watcher, restock monitor and notification service. There is a Server Side Template Injection (SSTI) in Jinja2 that allows Remote Command Execution on the server host. Attackers can run any system command without any restriction and they could use a reverse shell. The impact is critical as the attacker can completely takeove...

items.title: CVE-2026-111218: Netgate pfSense CE OS command injection in traffic shaper limiters (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Netgate pfSense CE and Netgate pfSense Plus contain an OS command injection flaw in the Traffic Shaper Limiters feature. A remote attacker who has logged in with Traffic Shaper Limiters privileges can edit a limiter's number value and then delete that limiter, which runs arbitrary shell commands as root.

items.title: CVE-2017-17733: Remote command execution in search via wd parameter (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Maccms 8.x contains a flaw that lets an attacker run arbitrary commands on the server through the wd parameter of a vod-search request. The attack can be carried out remotely, without logging in.

items.title: Podatność w oprogramowaniu Axence nVision
items.summary: W oprogramowaniu Axence nVision wykryto podatność polegającą na niewłaściwym przesyłaniu tokenów sesyjnych (CVE-2026-87850).

items.title: Cisco、Java4Shell影響の22製品を公表。IOS XEとUCS Centralは対象外に
items.summary: OpenJDKの脆弱性Java4Shell（CVE-2026-114938）についてCiscoが製品別の影響判定を改訂した。ルーターやスイッチを動かすIOS XEは影響なし。一方で管理・分析・コンタクトセンター系の22製品が影響対象に入り、修正リリースの大半は未定のまま残っている。

items.title: CVE-2026-21589: Atlassian remote file read in web application root (Update: Metasploit module published)
items.summary: Update: Metasploit module published. Atlassian's Bamboo, Bitbucket, Confluence, Crowd, Crucible, Fisheye, Jira Service Management and Jira Software Data Center products have a flaw that lets an attacker read specific files in the web application root directory, which may expose sensitive files in some configurations. The attacker can do this remotely without logging in, but must already know the exact name and path of the file, an...

items.title: CVE-2014-0780: InduSoft Web Studio admin password disclosure via path traversal in web server (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. InduSoft Web Studio, an industrial automation and HMI development software, is affected by this vulnerability. A remote attacker can send specially crafted web requests to read administrative passwords stored in application files, which could then be used to run arbitrary code on the system.

items.title: CVE-2016-2388: SAP NetWeaver AS JAVA information disclosure in Universal Worklist configuration (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. The Universal Worklist Configuration component of SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java is affected by this vulnerability. A remote attacker could send a specially crafted HTTP request to obtain sensitive user information.

items.title: USN-9037-2: HPLIP regression
items.summary: USN-9037-1 fixed vulnerabilities in HPLIP. Unfortunately, the upstream fix introduced a regression that caused scanning to fail on certain HP devices. This update fixes the problem. Original advisory details: It was discovered that HPLIP did not properly handle certain data, which could result in an out-of-bounds write. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service, expose sensitive information or execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-91097) It was discovered that HPLIP did not properly handle certain input, which could result in a heap-based buffer overflow. An attacker c…

items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. When evaluating access permissions, Keycloak Authorization Services improperly matches resource paths containing wildcard file extensions by evaluating only the file extension suffix and ignoring configured path prefixes. An authenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by requesting a restricted resource that shares a file extension with a more permissive resource, leading to an authorization bypass and unintended access to protected data.

items.title: CVE-2026-133226
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. The Account API endpoint for sharing resources fails to verify whether owner-managed access is enabled and accepts permission scopes not assigned to the resource. An authenticated user can exploit this vulnerability to generate pre-granted permission tickets, causing Keycloak to bypass policy evaluation and issue access tokens with unauthorized scopes.

items.title: CVE-2026-133413
items.summary: A vulnerability was detected in smartalock wireguard-lwip up to cfba91666590e86bd67842c71cedf9a423be823a. This affects the function wireguard_generate_unique_index of the file src/wireguard.c of the component Session Index Allocator. The manipulation of the argument receiver_index results in allocation of resources. The attack is only possible with local access. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.title: CVE-2026-133479
items.summary: A vulnerability was detected in WebKul QloApps up to 1.8.0. Affected by this vulnerability is the function postProcessDownload/installTheme of the file controllers/admin/AdminModulesController.php of the component Archive Import. The manipulation results in path traversal. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-133478
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in rajesh2211 Doctor-Appointment-System up to ee974dcf4c50da85e6ea026e27f4370e9468b3cc. Affected is an unknown function of the file AppointmentSystem/AppointmentSystem/Connectivity.php of the component Login. The manipulation of the argument User leads to sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. This product is using a rolling release to provide continious delivery. Therefore, no version details for affected nor updated releases are available.

items.title: CVE-2026-133520
items.summary: Dokploy 0.28.0 before 0.31.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the patch.readRepoDirectories tRPC procedure that allows authenticated organization members to list tracked files of arbitrary git repositories. Attackers with service read permission can supply a crafted repoPath, which is passed to git ls-tree unconfined, to enumerate other organizations' application and compose source trees.

items.title: CVE-2026-65094
items.summary: NVIDIA VIRTIO-Net for Bluefield contains a vulnerability in Virtio-Net where a VM user may cause a Write-What-Where condition by crafted message. A successful exploit of this vulnerability may lead to Code Execution in Virtio-Net scope.

items.title: CVE-2026-24205
items.summary: NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM for any platform contains a vulnerability where a user may cause a race condition by running concurrent requests. A successful exploit of this vulnerability may lead to data tampering.

items.title: CVE-2026-133415
items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in sumiie24 School-Management-System up to d946d649c7c95e101fc5679ecd91999533bb10d7. The affected element is an unknown function of the file parent_Registration.php. Such manipulation of the argument student_reg leads to sql injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. This product implements a rolling release for ongoing delivery, which means version information for affected or updated releases is unavailable.

items.title: CVE-2026-133414
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in sofastack sofa-bolt up to 1.6.12. Affected by this issue is the function HessianSerializer.deserialize of the file src/main/java/com/alipay/remoting/serialization/HessianSerializer.java of the component Hessian2 Deserialization. Performing a manipulation results in allocation of resources. The attack can be initiated remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-102430
items.summary: An uncontrolled recursion vulnerability exists in the LINE iOS app prior to version 26.19.0. The Flex Message processing component does not adequately validate the structure of externally supplied message content. As a result, an attacker who is able to send a crafted message to a victim could cause the application to crash when the message is received or displayed. A server-side mitigation has been deployed that also protects existing iOS clients that have not been updated to version 26.19.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-133228
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. When a client application enforces step-up authentication or multi-factor authentication (MFA) via a minimum authentication level, Keycloak fails to apply this requirement to login sessions initiated through the credential reset endpoint. An attacker who possesses a user's initial credentials (such as a password) can navigate from the reset interface back to the standard login form and authenticate without completing the required second factor. This flaw allows an attacker to obtain valid access tokens and gain unauthorized access to protected services without sat…

items.title: CVE-2026-133225
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. When processing token requests using the User-Managed Access (UMA) grant, Keycloak fails to verify whether a target client or resource server is enabled before issuing an authorization token. An authenticated remote user can exploit this flaw to obtain valid Requesting Party Tokens (RPTs) for disabled clients, bypassing administrative access controls and permissions restrictions.

items.title: CVE-2026-133224
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. When an administrator revokes tokens by setting a not-before revocation cutoff, Keycloak fails to enforce this boundary when processing User-Managed Access (UMA) grant requests using ID token claims. An authenticated remote user with an active session can submit a previously revoked ID token to receive a fresh Requesting Party Token (RPT). This flaw allows an attacker to bypass token revocation and retain unauthorized access to protected resources.

items.title: CVE-2025-71473
items.summary: lwext4 through 1.0.0 contains a heap buffer overflow in ext4_fs_init_inode_bitmap() in src/ext4_fs.c because it does not validate s_inodes_per_group against the inode bitmap size. Attackers can supply a crafted ext4 image with an oversized s_inodes_per_group so memset writes past the heap buffer, corrupting memory and crashing the mounting application.

items.title: CVE-2026-133528
items.summary: BeamNG.drive before 0.40.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability because JIT-compiled LuaJIT traces omit FFI array bounds checks, letting untrusted Lua escape the sandbox. Attackers supplying a malicious mod can JIT-compile an FFI store loop, write out of range using a tostring() address leak, re-enable ffi.load, and run commands as the game user.

items.title: CVE-2026-133521
items.summary: Bar Assistant 3.0.0 before 6.11.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in BarController::join that allows authenticated users to join bars without a valid invite code. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/bars/join omitting invite_code, matching invite-disabled bars with NULL codes, to read cocktails, ingredients, members, settings and search tokens.

items.title: CVE-2026-133519
items.summary: FFmpeg 7.0 through 9.0.2 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dvdvideo_menu_next_ps_block() in libavformat/dvdvideodec.c when demuxing DVD menu domains. Attackers can craft a DVD image whose last cell sector and NAV next-VOBU pointer bypass the end-of-cell check, overreading pgc->cell_playback and crashing the process.

items.title: CVE-2025-71474
items.summary: lwext4 through 1.0.0 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in ext4_fs_init_block_bitmap() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted superblock geometry fields. Attackers can supply an ext4 image with oversized s_reserved_gdt_blocks and BLOCK_UNINIT groups to write past the bitmap buffer, crashing applications that mount it.

items.title: CVE-2026-133406
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in aoiflux mutant 2.3.0/2.4.0/2.5.0. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file builtin/hive_builtins.go of the component Forensic Parser. This manipulation of the argument Count causes uncontrolled memory allocation. It is possible to launch the attack on the local host. Upgrading to version 2.6.0 is able to resolve this issue. Patch name: c4b1a7dec6c603115e2a05d1e8970a142f0b9774. Upgrading the affected component is recommended.

items.title: CVE-2026-15223
items.summary: An improper export control defect in ChatEventDispatchActivity (com.vivo.agent.business.chatmode.activity.ChatEventDispatchActivity) of Vivo Assistant allows a local malicious application to execute voice commands without user interaction via a crafted Intent, which may lead to unauthorized phone calls, SMS sending, access to private data such as location and calendar entries, and modification of system settings

items.title: CVE-2026-133480
items.summary: A flaw has been found in hrshadhin CloudSchool up to 3.0.1. Affected by this issue is the function PublicController.checkSanity4Student of the file app/Http/Controllers/Backend/PublicController.php of the component Student Data Access Check. This manipulation of the argument student_id causes authorization bypass. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.title: CVE-2026-116830
items.summary: Missing release of resource after effective lifetime vulnerability in Apache Tomcat's HTTP/2 initial connection handling leads to DoS. This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.0-M1 through 11.0.27, from 10.1.0-M1 through 10.1.61, from 9.0.20 through 9.0.123. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 11.0.29, 10.1.62 or 9.0.124, which fix the issue. Note: Tomcat 11.0.28 was not released

items.title: CVE-2026-133536
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. The OpenID Connect (OIDC) logout endpoint continues to honor post-logout redirect rules for disabled clients rather than rejecting the requests. If a disabled client retains permissive redirect configurations, a remote attacker can exploit this issue by supplying an arbitrary redirection target in a logout request, leading to an open redirect that can be used in phishing attacks.

items.summary: Reliance on obfuscation or encryption of Security-Relevant inputs without integrity checking, Improper validation of integrity check value, Cleartext transmission of sensitive information vulnerability in the EncryptInterceptor of Apache Tomcat. items.title: CVE-2026-82342
items.summary: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 is vulnerable to a stack-based buffer overflow when processing a specially crafted PROXY protocol v1 header. A remote attacker can exploit this vulnerability to cause a denial of service or potentially execute arbitrary code.

items.title: CVE-2026-133327
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in Dolibarr ERP CRM up to 23.0.4. This affects the function dol_convert_file in the library htdocs/core/lib/files.lib.php of the component Document Upload. Such manipulation leads to code injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. Upgrading to version 24.0.0 is able to mitigate this issue. The name of the patch is 9b6368b2a9eae3eec690b2ce22c4f291f0051540. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

items.title: CVE-2026-122676
items.summary: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in PublishPress PublishPress Authors publishpress-authors allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects PublishPress Authors: from n/a through 4.18.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-84273
items.summary: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 is vulnerable to path traversal in the datasource functionality. An authenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability to delete arbitrary files on the appliance.

items.title: CVE-2026-133535
items.summary: A flaw was found in Hawtio. An authenticated remote attacker can cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by sending a specially crafted request URI to monitored endpoints. The FlightRecordingDownloadFacade servlet filter uses an inefficient regular expression pattern that causes catastrophic backtracking when processing certain long requests. This issue leads to excessive CPU utilization, causing handling threads to hang and degrading service availability.

items.title: CVE-2026-133477
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in sofastack sofa-bolt up to 1.6.12. This impacts the function initSSLContext of the file src/main/java/com/alipay/remoting/connection/AbstractConnectionFactory.java of the component TLS Stack. Executing a manipulation can lead to certificate with host mismatch. The attack may be performed from remote. This attack is characterized by high complexity. The exploitability is said to be difficult. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-131303
items.summary: In Splunk AI Assistant versions below 2.0.0, a user who does not hold the "admin" or "power" Splunk roles could obtain limited information about indexes and data sources outside their authorized scope through the assistant. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk AI Assistant does not fully apply authorization controls to all information that it retrieves.

items.title: CVE-2026-131287
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the Playbooks view, edit, execute, and delete permissions could cause existing cross-repository playbook references to run attacker-controlled playbook code. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR can bind existing cross-repository playbook references to a different source control repository when a deleted repository name is reused.

items.title: CVE-2026-131280
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user whose role grants system_settings:view but not assets:view could access asset and application inventory, tenant identifiers, connector run messages, and stored configuration snapshots through the ingestion status Representational State Transfer (REST) API. The vulnerability is possible because the ingestion status REST API checks the system_settings:view permission but does not enforce assets:view or tenant restrictions before it returns asset-derived ingestion records. For more information see Manage roles and permissions in Splunk SO…

items.title: CVE-2026-131277
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with permission to edit playbooks and repositories could store a modified utility block in a playbook. If a user that holds a role with permission to edit playbook code later opens and saves the playbook in the Visual Playbook Editor, a subsequent playbook run could send a Representational State Transfer (REST) API delete request to a resource outside the intended data list. The user account that runs the playbook must have permission to delete the target resource. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not prevent a…

items.title: CVE-2026-131271
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to view and edit containers for one label could use a slash command through the Representational State Transfer (REST) API to access sensitive product data and credentials outside the authorized container scope. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not enforce authorization for related objects that slash commands access from an authorized artifact.

items.title: CVE-2026-131270
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with repository edit access could cause Splunk SOAR to write files outside the configured repository, which lets the user modify files that the user account running Splunk SOAR can write to. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not require source control repository paths to remain inside the configured repository.

items.title: CVE-2026-131259
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with permission to create and view containers for a label could use the Representational State Transfer (REST) API to create a container that references a workbook phase in a case the user cannot view, disclosing the phase name and creating an inconsistent phase association. The vulnerability exists because the Container REST API does not enforce the same case-scoped authorization when it accepts a workbook-phase reference during container creation.

items.title: CVE-2026-131256
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user that holds a role with the System Settings edit permission could execute arbitrary code on the host that runs Splunk SOAR. The vulnerability is possible because the Representational State Transfer (REST) API accepts package references from untrusted sources and passes them to the dependency installer.

items.title: CVE-2026-131248
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the System Settings edit permission and restricted tenant access could modify settings for a tenant outside the role scope through the Representational State Transfer (REST) API. With this access, the user could expose confidential tenant environment values, alter tenant settings and automation behavior, or take the tenant out of operation. The vulnerability is possible because the Tenant REST API checks the System Settings edit permission but does not enforce the tenant restrictions for the role before it updates the selected…

items.title: CVE-2026-131877
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via unbounded arc length in OBJECT IDENTIFIER decoding and encoding. The content of an OBJECT IDENTIFIER or RELATIVE-OID element is passed to unpack "w*" on decode, and the arcs of an OID string to pack "w*" on encode. Perl converts each arc to or from its decimal string in time quadratic in the arc's length, and nothing limits that length. An attacker who controls the decoded data, or an OID string passed to encode, can exhaust CPU with a single oversized arc.

items.title: CVE-2026-131868
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow memory exhaustion via a declared element length passed unchecked to sysread in asn_read and asn_get. The length an element declares in its BER header is passed to sysread as the read size. Perl grows the target buffer to that size before reading, so memory is allocated from the declared length, not from the data received. A 6-byte header can declare a length of up to 4GB. A single header makes the reading process allocate the declared size. Where the allocation fails, perl exits with "Out of memory", which eval cannot catch.

items.title: CVE-2026-126956
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow memory exhaustion via unlimited recursion depth in constructed-form string decoding. Any constructed-form string element causes the decoder to recurse on the element's contents. The BER encoding controls nesting depth at four bytes per level, with no bound checked. Perl recursion is heap-allocated, so the process grows without a stack crash. An attacker who controls the decoded data can exhaust memory with a small deeply nested constructed string.

In the constructed form each zero-length segment copies the rest of the input again, so memory grows with the square of the input size. items.title: CVE-2026-126682
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via exponent-notation string in INTEGER encoding. The encoder routes any value with abs >= 2**31 to i2osp without validating that it is an integer. A string in exponent notation such as "1e8000" passes that threshold. Math::BigInt expands it to an 8001-digit integer, and i2osp's per-octet conversion loop is quadratic in that size. An attacker who controls encoded INTEGER values can exhaust CPU with a short exponent-notation string.

When asn_decode_length returns no value because the length is absent or incomplete, no exit fires for that case either. items.title: CVE-2026-126540
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via quadratic bigint loop in os2ip. Every INTEGER or ENUMERATED longer than four content octets reaches os2ip, which iterates over each content octet with $result = ($result * 256) + $octet. Each multiplication operates on a bigint that grows by one octet per step, so decoding an n-octet value takes O(n^2) bigint work. Nothing limits content length before this loop runs. An attacker who controls the decoded data can exhaust CPU with a single oversized INTEGER or ENUMERATED value.

items.title: CVE-2026-77315
items.summary: Flyto2 Core is an execution kernel for automation and AI-agent workflows. Prior to 2.26.8, http.paginate in src/core/modules/atomic/http/paginate.py validates only the initial base_url, and _paginate_link_header then follows a server-supplied Link: rel="next" URL without calling the SSRF guard again. A low-privileged caller can make an allowed first page point the next request at an internal or metadata service, causing a readable second-order SSRF whose response body is aggregated into all_items and returned. This issue is fixed in version 2.26.8.

items.title: CVE-2026-133481
items.summary: In Dolibarr before 24.0.3, /api/index.php/eventattendees discloses attendee and project data regardless of the caller's permissions. Only 22.0.0 and later (where api_eventattendees.class.php exists) are affected. A remote authenticated user can obtain column values one character at a time.

items.title: CVE-2026-133248
items.summary: modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows administrators with product editing permission to inject script via the products_name field. The unescaped name is rendered in the h1 heading of product detail and reviews pages, executing script in the browsers of shoppers and logged-in customers.

items.title: CVE-2026-129225
items.summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. In 3.10.3 and earlier, DependencyGraph._tree and triples recurse once per dependency edge without a depth bound, and get_cycle_path also lacks a visited-set termination guard. A deeply chained or cyclic attacker-controlled CoNLL or Malt-TAB dependency structure can raise RecursionError and abort a parse worker. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-128140
items.summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. From 3.6.7 until 3.10.4, nltk.downloader follows collection membership without tracking already visited collection nodes. A self-referencing or mutually referencing collection index can therefore make the package-closure walk loop indefinitely while its queue and memory usage grow, denying service when a victim processes the attacker-influenced index. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-129230
items.summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, WordNet Synset.max_depth, min_depth, hypernym_paths, and hypernym_distances recursively follow attacker-controlled corpus pointers without a visited-node set or depth cap. A cyclic or excessively deep hypernym graph can raise RecursionError and terminate traversal APIs and similarity operations that depend on them. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-129226
items.summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, the semantic-logic read_type parser recursively processes both halves of nested complex type strings without applying LogicParser.MAX_PARSE_DEPTH. An attacker-controlled type string or signature with excessive nesting can raise RecursionError through Type.fromstring or type-checking entry points and abort the current worker. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-129222
items.summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, DependencyGraph.tree and DependencyGraph.triples walk parsed dependency edges through unbounded Python recursion and do not use a working cycle or depth guard. A crafted CoNLL or Malt-TAB dependency file containing a sufficiently long chain can raise RecursionError when the documented traversal APIs are called, aborting the current worker. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-133168
items.summary: OFFIS DCMTK 3.7.1 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in togglePlanarConfiguration8 and togglePlanarConfiguration16 in djcodece.cc, which compute row offsets using rows instead of columns. Attackers can supply a crafted color-by-plane DICOM image with more rows than columns that is compressed with the true-lossless JPEG codec to corrupt heap memory, causing crashes and potentially code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-133172
items.summary: Cozy Cloud cozy-stack 1.6.62 before 1.6.69 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the shared-drive move handler that allows authenticated users to access other instances' files. Attackers owning a shared drive can name another instance's domain and any directory ID as the move source to copy and delete the victim's file tree.

items.title: CVE-2026-133169
items.summary: modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to inject scripts via the unsanitized products_model field. Attackers with product editing permission can store JavaScript that executes in browsers of other administrators, storefront visitors, and customers viewing carts and order history.

items.title: CVE-2026-129404
items.summary: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Missing SQL statement permission check in form import and field creation in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - The core.create.sql.statement permission was not enforced when importing forms or creating new fields, allowing backend users without this permission to store arbitrary SQL statements.

items.title: CVE-2026-129234
items.summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, Prover9Parent.config_prover9 and Mace accept a relative binary_location and pass it to find_binary as path_to_bin, disabling the bare-name absolute-path guard. A local attacker who can plant prover9 or mace4 in the resolved working directory can cause subprocess.Popen to execute that binary with the invoking user's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-129232
items.summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, XMLCorpusView.read_block rebuilds the full root-to-node context path with "/".join(context) for every start tag while searching for a matching element. Deeply nested attacker-influenced corpus XML therefore causes quadratic pure-Python work and can pin a processing worker, resulting in denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-129231
items.summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, SeekableUnicodeStreamReader.readline appends each new block to a growing character buffer and reruns splitlines over the entire buffer on every iteration. An attacker-controlled corpus file containing one very long unterminated line therefore causes quadratic CPU consumption in line-oriented corpus readers and can deny service. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-129221
items.summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, nltk.classify.weka.ARFF_Formatter writes attacker-controlled class labels into the Weka ARFF @ATTRIBUTE '-label-' declaration without safely formatting the label tokens. Crafted labels can alter the generated ARFF schema or records, corrupting classifier input and causing integrity loss or processing failure. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-83631
items.summary: On Intel-based macOS systems, the Okta Device Access (ODA) component of Okta Verify for macOS configures a LaunchDaemon service whose program path resolves via a symbolic link in /usr/local/bin. In environments where non-standard directory permissions grant local non-root users write access to this path, the symbolic link target can be modified, causing the LaunchDaemon to execute the replacement binary upon service restart.

items.title: CVE-2026-132607
items.summary: Insufficient verification of data authenticity in the decryption component of Amazon S3 Encryption Client for PHP in AWS SDK for PHP before 3.383.1 might allow an authenticated remote user to forge ciphertext that decrypts to arbitrary plaintext via manipulation of the GCM authentication tag length metadata. To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to AWS SDK for PHP version 3.383.1 or later.

items.title: CVE-2026-130236
items.summary: In the Auth0 Authorization Extension, request authentication handling can process claims from query parameters independently of header validation. Under specific preconditions, this may allow an authenticated tenant user to issue requests to the extension's administrative endpoints. Also, input handling during rule generation may permit modification of the tenant login rule published by the extension.

items.title: CVE-2026-130235
items.summary: In the Okta .NET SDK Abstractions library, outbound HTTP requests are not restricted to the configured Okta organization domain when processing certain URL formats. If a URL parameter is modified to specify an external host, the library may transmit the configured SSWS API token to that unintended destination.

items.title: CVE-2026-130233
items.summary: The Okta .NET SDK Abstractions library improperly synchronizes authentication credentials set on a shared HTTP client during request execution. When concurrent requests are dispatched for different principals, one principal's credential may be transmitted on an outbound request intended for another principal, which can result in credential exposure and lead to unauthorized actions performed as the affected principal at the Okta Management API.

items.title: CVE-2026-130153
items.summary: The Okta Client SDK for Python (okta-client-python) includes client authentication values (client_secret or JWT assertions) as query parameters in the front-channel authorization URL when executing the authorization code flow without Pushed Authorization Requests (PAR). When PAR is disabled, unsupported by the authorization server, or fails, the SDK falls back to standard authorization URL construction, transmitting these parameters via user-agent requests.

items.title: CVE-2026-69261

Authorization headers are never forwarded to inappropriate hosts and are not the affected secret in this vulnerability. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.1.

items.summary: The MongoDB Java Driver does not neutralize NUL characters in the user name and password values it places into the message it builds for SASL PLAIN authentication. When a non-internal pull or a feed processes incoming data and encounters an existing sharing group, the application did not verify that the remote server's organization was actually a member of that sharing group before allowing the group's metadata to be updated. items.title: CVE-2026-133174
items.summary: HotGo 2.18.6 through 2.19.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated backend users to read other administrators' private letters because the messageIds helper omits the receiver filter. Low-privilege users can call GET /admin/notice/pullMessages, which is exempt from role permission checks via exceptAuth, to retrieve titles, contents and senders of private letters.

items.title: CVE-2026-133171
items.summary: Tiptap @tiptap/core 3.7.0 before 3.30.5 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability in parseAttributes and parseShortcodeAttributes that allows attackers to exhaust CPU through quadratic backtracking. Attackers can supply Markdown with long crafted attribute strings parsed by createBlockMarkdownSpec, createAtomBlockMarkdownSpec or createInlineMarkdownSpec to stall browser pages or server processes.

items.title: CVE-2026-133170
items.summary: Tiptap @tiptap/core 2.0.0-alpha.0 before 3.30.4 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject DOM attributes via a __proto__ key passed to mergeAttributes(). Attackers can supply untrusted JSON attribute data whose __proto__ replaces the merged object's prototype, causing DOMSerializer.renderSpec to render injected event handlers that execute JavaScript.

items.title: CVE-2026-99406
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: fix lost errno returned from xfarray_foliosort LOLLM noticed that we stop the sort early but don't actually pass along the error code, which could enable repair code to continue running with an unsorted array. Fix that.

items.title: CVE-2026-99405
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: abort dirtree repair if the live update hook dies LOLLM notices that if the live update hook for the directory tree repair code hits an error, it will set dl->aborted and stops working. If the repair code ever sees that condition, it ought to bail out immediately instead of continuing with obsolete data.

items.title: CVE-2026-99404
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: check fork type against dabtree block magic number LOLLM complains that we fail to flag dabtree blocks that should never be associated with the file fork -- data forks can't point to xattr leaves, and attr forks can't point to dirent blocks. Add the missing checks.

items.title: CVE-2026-99403
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: mark overfull dabtree node blocks as corrupt LOLLM observes that we need to range-check the dabtree node record count before using it to index an array. Fix that.

items.title: CVE-2026-99402
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: netfilter: nft_payload: restrict checksum offsets to known values We need to prevent userspace from corrupting e.g. tcp->doff, because many locations in conntrack and conntrack helpers rely on nf_conntrack_in() having validated the packet headers. nft_payload allows to alter headers later which invalidates this assumption. The 'Fixes' commit restricts writes to safe fields, but there is another side channel: the checksum location. Restrict this too. Reported via sashiko/gemini.

items.title: CVE-2026-133074
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Insufficient authorization checks in the quiz overrides web service allow an authenticated user with teacher privileges to modify user and group overrides for quizzes they do not have permission to manage. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to improperly alter exam access, deadlines, or testing conditions across unauthorized courses.

items.title: CVE-2026-133073
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle's single view grade report web service. A missing authorization check allows authenticated students to view the names of all grade items in a course, including those configured to be hidden. This vulnerability leads to unauthorized information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-133068
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. An improper authorization check when displaying individual glossary entries allows an authenticated user to view approved glossary items from courses they do not have permission to access. This vulnerability leads to unauthorized information disclosure of restricted educational materials.

items.title: CVE-2026-133067
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to missing ownership checks in badge alignments, an authenticated user with badge management privileges can view and modify alignments associated with badges they do not own. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized data disclosure and tampering with badge configurations.

items.title: CVE-2026-133060
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle's Blackboard question import format. Insufficient validation of file paths during the question import process allows an authenticated user with permissions to import questions into a question bank to read arbitrary files accessible to the web server process. An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to view sensitive files, resulting in unauthorized information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-133059
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. The grade feedback web service does not properly verify group and course enrolment permissions. An authenticated user with non-editing teacher privileges can exploit this vulnerability to access grade feedback and user profile details across groups or courses they are not authorized to view, leading to unauthorized information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-129927

If that connection string carries a secret, the secret may be disclosed in cleartext through the application's error output or logs. items.title: CVE-2026-133114

items.title: CVE-2026-131610
items.summary: In ConnectWise Automate versions prior to 2026.11, a condition in Web Control Center (WCC2) authorization handling could allow an authenticated contact user to access information associated with other clients on the same Automate server through API requests. This may result in disclosure of information outside the user’s assigned access scope. The issue is limited to information disclosure and does not extend existing modification or command execution permissions. This issue is resolved in ConnectWise Automate 2026.11.

items.title: CVE-2026-105803
items.summary: Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files. From 1.3.0 until 3.8.1, Git LFS does not correctly filter the limited set of options permitted in a repository's .lfsconfig file when option keys contain certain additional components. Crafted keys can mimic options that configure Git LFS to use a custom command to transfer objects, causing Git LFS to execute an attacker-selected command or binary while fetching objects. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-105802
items.summary: Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files. From 0.6.0 until 3.8.1, Git LFS reads Git configuration options defined for a submodule without checking certain values for embedded line-ending control characters. A malicious repository can insert control characters such as line feed (LF) into those values to mimic options that cause Git LFS to execute an attacker-controlled command or binary while fetching or adding objects. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-87956
items.summary: When Private data source connect (PDC) or a secure SOCKS proxy is used, the MQTT data source plugin does not apply TLS to broker connections for the tls, ssl, tcps, mqtts and mqtt+ssl schemes. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2…

items.title: CVE-2026-62258
items.summary: HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, the CRAM decoder validates the 254-character query-name limit only after decoding the name into a 1024-byte stack array. An attacker-controlled CRAM record can provide an overlong query name and overflow the local stack buffer before the later validation runs; all CRAM format versions are affected. Opening such a file can crash the process, corrupt stack data, and may permit arbitrary code execution. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24.

items.title: CVE-2026-62256
items.summary: HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, fai_retrieve does not verify that the line width recorded in a FASTA .fai index is greater than or equal to the number of bases per line. When the line width is exactly one less than the base count, retrieval allocates an undersized heap buffer and writes one byte beyond its end; larger discrepancies instead cause an allocation failure that is handled. This issue can corrupt heap memory and crash the process. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24.

items.title: CVE-2026-133075
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to insufficient authorization checks in the quiz random question filter web service, an authenticated user with teacher privileges can modify random question settings in quizzes they do not have permission to manage. This flaw allows unauthorized users to alter assessment configurations across courses they do not oversee.

items.title: CVE-2026-133072
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Insufficient authorization checks in the quiz editing functionality allow an authenticated user with teacher privileges to view slot details and modify sections of quizzes they do not have permission to manage. An attacker could exploit this flaw to alter quiz configurations or disclose quiz structure information without proper authorization.

items.title: CVE-2026-133071
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to a missing authorization check when editing Lesson activity pages, authenticated users with teacher privileges can view and move lesson pages from courses they are not permitted to access into their own lessons. This issue can lead to unauthorized access and modification of restricted course content.

items.title: CVE-2026-133070
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to a missing authorization check when viewing and restoring wiki page versions, an authenticated user can access content from courses they are not permitted to view. This issue allows an attacker to inspect restricted course material and copy it into their own wiki pages, leading to unauthorized information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-133069
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Missing authorization checks in the forum discussion web services allow authenticated users to view discussion information in courses they do not have permission to access. In addition, users with teacher privileges may lock forum discussions in courses where they lack proper authorization. This issue can lead to unauthorized information disclosure and unauthorized discussion state modification.

items.title: CVE-2026-133066
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Missing ownership verification in Feedback activity templates allows an authenticated teacher to view, use, or delete templates associated with courses other than their own. This can result in unauthorized access, modification, or deletion of course materials.

items.title: CVE-2026-133065
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to insufficient permission checks and input validation in the quiz question bank callback, an authenticated user can access and view questions from question banks they do not have permission to access. Furthermore, this issue allows users to trigger arbitrary class instantiation (creating unintended application objects), potentially leading to further unauthorized actions.

items.title: CVE-2026-133064
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Insufficient sanitization of objective identifiers in the SCORM (Sharable Content Object Reference Model) objectives report allows an authenticated user with content upload permissions to inject malicious scripts. When another user views the report, the injected script executes in their browser session, potentially allowing the attacker to access sensitive information or perform unauthorized actions on their behalf.

items.title: CVE-2026-133063
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to insufficient validation when saving activity settings, an authenticated user with teacher privileges can modify activities in courses they are not authorized to access. This flaw allows unauthorized changes to course materials, compromising the integrity of course content.

items.title: CVE-2026-133062
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle's external database enrolment plugin. Insufficient sanitization of data passed to queries against the external database allows an authenticated user with course editing permissions to perform a Structured Query Language (SQL) injection attack. When this non-default plugin is enabled, an attacker can exploit this issue to view, modify, or delete sensitive records within the connected external database.

items.title: CVE-2026-133061

Due to a missing capability check in the grade items web service, an authenticated user with a student role can view the names of all grade items in a course, including those intended to be hidden. This flaw leads to unauthorized information disclosure of hidden course assessment details.

items.title: CVE-2026-130745

Routine editor activity through the API plugin rebuilds the page index without frontmatter.yaml access rules, exposing members-only page content until the cache is rebuilt.

Attackers can abuse the import@ directive, uploaded YAML media named as the page template, or form.flash_folder to leak password hashes and keys or invoke static PHP methods for code execution.

Attackers can repoint page objects or overwrite the assets collections to render private keys and the API signing secret, then forge a super-admin API token.

items.title: CVE-2026-130740
